name: Calle Alberto 22-40 · covered porch off Calle Eva east
trust: IMG_2792 shows the porch: an arch on square piers with a stepped impost, a red studded ramp running in beside the south pier (right in the photo), a tiled step platform with a potted jade and a big-leaved plant to the north (left), and a plain white back wall about 1-2 m in carrying black letter tiles CALLE ALBERTO 22 40 and a white AGUA POTABLE hatch; the passage must turn out of view. The camera pin (+/-4.7 m) faces the only recess in this registry facade, 3.1 m wide and 1.0 m deep, so the porch is placed in it; its exact width, depth, arch span, step heights and furniture positions are estimates. The phone compass reads 289 degrees, about 50 degrees west of the direction into this recess (239); compass error beside walls is common in this set, but it is why the placement stays an estimate.

frame.about: origin is the south corner of the recess on the facade line; along runs north-north-east along the facade; in runs into the house (west-north-west). Both inherit the registry's roughly 1-1.5 m offset.

route.why: The registry footprint of this block has an inner courtyard whose east edge is about 7.4 m beyond the porch's back wall; the porch is the only recess in the facade and its plaque names the houses 22-40, so a covered passage most likely links it to the courtyard. Which way it turns behind the back wall, its width, height and line are not seen; drawn on the map only, not cut through the house in 3D.
